sloka: तत्र ताराधिपस्याभा ताराणां च तथैव च।तयोराभरणस्था च बलयोर्द्यामभासयन् ।। ६.७५.५० ।।
transliteration: tatra tārādhipasyābhā tārāṇāṁ ca tathaiva ca।tayorābharaṇasthā ca balayordyāmabhāsayan ।। 6.75.50 ।।

translations.english: Ordered by him again and again, the Rakshasa warriors went from Lanka with glowing weapons offering salutations to him.
translations.hindi: त्रिशिरा, सहोदर और दुधऽं देवान्तक एवं नरान्तक को मरा हुआ देख,
